label: No placebo
rationale: This is a crossover device-assessment study where participants complete training and digital tasks with multiple assistive technologies/BCIs, not a placebo-controlled drug trial. The record describes active device comparisons and a sham comparator is not present; instead, participants experience each device in randomized order, including a healthy control cohort and device-user cohorts.

evidence.quote: Participants in this arm will undergo training and a digital assessment using 3 assistive technologies (eye tracker, mouth-operated joystick, non-invasive electroencephalogram (EEG) headset), brain-computer-interfaces, and applicable personal ATs.
Participants will experience each of these devices in a randomized order.

Enrollment will involve three different cohorts, namely a cohort of healthy participant, a cohort of ALS/SCI participant who underwent the implant of an invasive BCI device, and a cohort of ALS/SCI participants without any implanted BCI device.

title: Clinical Outcome Assessment for AT & BCI

rule.label: No placebo
rule.reason: All recorded arms have recognized non-placebo types and no placebo mention in arms/interventions. Inferred from saved data; sham controls count as no placebo.
